eval_improvement_feedback: e2.5 — states the gap must be 'marked [CLIENT DATA NEEDED] / «απαιτούνται στοιχεία προϊόντος» in the report/gap-table sections'. A deliverable that names the gap in a dedicated gap table without the literal token satisfies the purpose but not the letter. Say whether the marker string is required or whether any explicit gap record in the report section counts — the strict reading would demand a bracket token that the skill's own Placement clause exists to confine.

e4.2 — 'keeping or recommending a single accurate type for the page' does not say whether FAQPage may be added when the optimization itself adds a visible FAQ to a page that already carries a type. The skill mandates that FAQ and its markup (C09, GEO-First priority #2), so the expectation and the skill currently point opposite ways on the e4 fixture. Resolve in the expectation and in SKILL.md:142 together; see D7-new.

e1.5 — 'never attributed to a source the user did not name' does not say whether the deliverable may name a plausible first-party document (here «αρχεία εργασιών της εταιρείας») for figures the prompt supplied without naming a document. Graded PASS on the grammatical reading that the clause governs additional, unsupplied metrics.

e3.7 — 'a derived figure presented without its derivation fails' does not say whether the derivation must accompany EVERY occurrence or appear once in the document. The e3 deliverable states '€6,400' and 'about 15 years' in the takeaways box and the table before showing the arithmetic at L81; graded PASS on the once-per-document reading.

e2.2 — the 40-80 word quota is well specified and was the only quantitative miss in the run; worth keeping verbatim. Consider whether the skill's own carrier should say 40-60 words as a floor rather than a target, since the carrier states '[Direct answer: 40-60 words]' while the expectation grades a 40-80 band.
